stem_md: $y\sin x+\frac{dy}{dx}\cos x=1$ 的积分因子为（ ）
analysis_md:
方程可化为

$$
(y\sin x-1)\,dx+\cos x\,dy=0,
$$

$$
P(x,y)=y\sin x-1,\quad Q(x,y)=\cos x,
$$

$$
\frac{\partial P}{\partial y}-\frac{\partial Q}{\partial x}=\sin x+\sin x=2\sin x,
$$

$$
\frac{1}{Q}\left(\frac{\partial P}{\partial y}-\frac{\partial Q}{\partial x}\right)=2\tan x,
$$

故积分因子为 $\mu(x)=e^{\int 2\tan x\,dx}=\cos^{-2}x,$
